scope: Original frozen module judged once on fresh Romanian sources. All 60 original records and all 158 module edges are explicitly covered. Nine prior holds are preserved outside the module. Changes below are conditions for source-pool acceptance; no application or landing authorization is issued.

fresh_web_evidence.source_acquisition_note: Fresh HTTP responses were read independently; temporary extracts and byte hashes remain in the authorized wave scratch. Failed web-tool PDF opens were superseded by successful direct primary-source retrieval, not treated as evidence.

quality_judgment.recognition_and_relevance: The batch consists of everyday body words, familiar inflection completions and school biology structures. A freshly retrieved grade-VII publisher manual provides a second school-recognition signal for skeletal and sensory vocabulary; no low frequency rank rejects concrete everyday terms.
quality_judgment.strict_sense: Ordinary inflections are inputs, not new synonyms. Anatomical senses are kept distinct from technical, figurative, botanical, proper-name and textile owners. Qualified Coastă/Măduvă/Coloană inputs preserve their restrictions; musical Voce and phonetic Sunet remain as currently served.
quality_judgment.morphology: All 51 selected families were freshly checked against exact-headword selected DEX/DOOM 3 IDs and the selected noun tables. Ordinary non-colliding paradigms, singular-only marrow and invariant keys are retained; elisions, vocatives, unsupported plurals and other-sense forms are excluded.
quality_judgment.graph: All 40 new concepts satisfy incident graph floors after directed deduplication: 4–8 distinct neighbors, at least 2 main, at least 2 same-category, at most 2 batch. No replacement endpoint or invented link is proposed.
quality_judgment.board_boundary: Generic body/organ/tissue/process vocabulary may improve shared guesses and graph coverage; it is not an approved generic filler group or hidden target. Complete partitions, pair uniqueness, route choice, recipe intuitiveness, salience bands and difficulty still need later full-board qualification.
source_cautions: Schelet_uman has a malformed bone-count lead; no count or developmental/clinical claim is accepted. Specific protection claims were read separately and corroborated by the primary school manual.
Geană has an erroneous etymology explaining the English word eyelash as Romanian geană; no etymology or cosmetic/clinical claim is accepted.

Lacrimă primary-provider passages, the university head-support passage and the hospital-hosted sweat terminology were directly retrieved and read; only their stated anatomical relationships are accepted.
quality_judgment.clinical_boundary: No diagnosis, treatment, care regimen, age/dose threshold or clinical ruling is part of this acceptance.
